title: Pay salaries from a sheet after the owner approves
summary: On payday, read the staff sheet, get the owner's approval, then pay each person by Paystack transfer and text them.
description: On the day of the month you choose, reads your staff sheet (columns: name, account_number, bank, amount, phone), asks someone with the approver role to approve the whole payroll, and only then pays each person into their bank account with a Paystack transfer (each payment carries an idempotency key, so a retry never pays twice) and texts them that their salary was sent. Nothing is paid if the payroll is rejected or not approved within a day.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: Named in the message to staff.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Staff spreadsheet
params.description: Paste the sheet's link from your browser.

params.name: sheet_range
params.title: Tab
params.description: The tab with your staff. Its first row names the columns: name, account_number, bank, amount (naira) and phone.

params.name: day_of_month
params.title: Payday
params.description: The day of the month salaries are paid (1 to 28).

params.name: approver_role
params.title: Who approves
params.description: The role that approves the payroll before anything is paid.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The Paystack account salaries are paid from.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

steps.name: For each person on the sheet
Save the person's bank account in Paystack
steps.when: =has(item.account_number) && item.account_number != null && has(item.bank) && item.bank != null && has(item.amount) && item.amount != null && double(item.amount) >= 1.0

steps.name: Pay the salary by Paystack transfer
Text the person that their salary was sent

input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': your salary of NGN ' + string(item.amount) + ' has been sent. Thank you for your work.'
